actions.assumptions_changed: Moving away from the assumption of frictionless reward convergence toward recognizing the role of systematic, path-dependent biases and structural mediation.
actions.new_frame: Experience-driven preference formation is fundamentally shaped by path-dependent inferential errors and structural mediation across operational stages.
actions.old_frame: Experience-driven preference formation can be understood purely through asymptotic reward convergence.
actions.reason: Clarifying the mechanisms by which stable preferences emerge in intelligent systems under model uncertainty.
actions.strategy: Analyze preference formation through the lens of path-dependent model misspecification and structural mediation.
